KIT's bslib theme

Source: R/setup.R
kit_theme.Rd

Based on Bootswatch Brite (available from bslib 0.11.0), with KIT's colors; all text uses the rounded typeface Chiron GoRound TC, code uses JetBrains Mono. Both typefaces are downloaded by the browser from Google Fonts on demand (local = FALSE): CJK typefaces are split into hundreds of unicode-range pieces, so the server does not fetch every font file at startup.

Usage

kit_theme(brand = kit_current_brand())

Arguments

brand

The brand (kit_brand()); defaults to kit_current_brand() (KIT when not set).

Value

A bslib::bs_theme() object.

Details

You usually do not need to call it yourself: kit_page() already uses it.

Colors come from the brand (kit_brand()): primary, success, navbar-bg, and link-color are the brand's primary; link-hover-color is primary_hover; body-bg is page; border-color is ink. info, warning, danger, and secondary are Bootstrap's own dark colors and do not change with the brand (the background colors of callouts and status boxes are in the CSS --nb-* variables, which do change with the brand). brand.yml is not read (bslib::bs_theme(brand = FALSE)): when the working directory or a parent has a _brand.yml (for example brand/_brand.yml), the theme does not change.

See also

kit_page(), use_kit(), kit_brand()

Examples

theme <- kit_theme()
bslib::theme_bootswatch(theme)
#> [1] "brite"
